description: Withdraw one match request, either a draft or an open one. Always pass its request_id. If it is unclear which one the user means, call check_matches first. The other requests of the user stay active. This voids a pending match from this request. It keeps a match that both people accepted.

request_id.description: The request_id from create_match_request or check_matches. Always name the exact request that the user approved, or asked you to withdraw.

name: withdraw_match_request
title: Withdraw the match request
